limitations: Anonymous browser captures verify visible installer and sign-in/update presentation; no authenticated Worker or Supervisor hosted fixtures were created.
These checks do not certify physical iPhone/Android installation, native sharing, phone storage capacity or camera QR scanning.
Waiting-update behavior, asset parity and cold-offline assertions belong to their functional proof files; this review verifies exact captured visuals and does not claim additional behavior tests.
